description:
### Summary Reproduced on GitLab `15.6.0` and GitLab.com `15.7.0-pre a893afc0100` If `Content-Type: multipart/formdata` is specified when using the [POST /api/v4/projects](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/api/projects.html#create-project) (create projects API) endpoint and an `avatar` is not specified in the form data, the request will fail with a `500`. Prior to GitLab `15.3`, this was not an issue. This MR https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/92604 was introduced in `15.4` where Workhorse now processes this API endpoint instead of Rails. ### Steps to reproduce Call the [POST /api/v4/projects](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/api/projects.html#create-project) (create projects API) endpoint using `Content-Type: multipart/formdata` : ```sh ❯ curl -i -H "PRIVATE-TOKEN:$GITLAB_PAT" -H "Content-Type: multipart/form-data" -H "Accept: application/json" -X POST https://gitlab.example.com/api/v4/projects?name=project-content-type-test3&namespace_id=83 HTTP/2 500 server: nginx date: Wed, 07 Dec 2022 20:36:51 GMT content-type: text/plain; charset=utf-8 content-length: 22 x-content-type-options: nosniff ``` The Workhorse logs will show a `handleFileUploads: extract files from multipart: get multipart reader: no multipart boundary param in Content-Type` error. If you add the `avatar` to the form data, the request succeeds: ```sh ❯ curl -i -H "PRIVATE-TOKEN:$GITLAB_PAT" -H "Content-Type: multipart/form-data" -H "Accept: application/json" --form "avatar=@1557219222408.jpg" -X POST https://gitlab.example.com/api/v4/projects?name=project-content-type-test3&namespace_id=83 HTTP/2 201 server: nginx date: Wed, 07 Dec 2022 20:35:45 GMT content-type: application/json cache-control: max-age=0, private, must-revalidate etag: W/"f179ce0e082928ee6b895415ab0469ec" vary: Origin x-content-type-options: nosniff x-frame-options: SAMEORIGIN x-request-id: 01GKQ4T80V6FA6Z0DEBT16QBG8 x-runtime: 1.891063 strict-transport-security: max-age=63072000 referrer-policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin ``` ### What is the current *bug* behavior? If `Content-Type: multipart/form-data` is specified when using the [POST /api/v4/projects](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/api/projects.html#create-project) (create projects API) endpoint without an `avatar` in the form data, a `500` is returned and the project is not created. ### What is the expected *correct* behavior? If `Content-Type: multipart/form-data` is specified when using the [POST /api/v4/projects](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/api/projects.html#create-project) (create projects API) endpoint without an `avatar` in the form data, it would be better if a `400` is shown instead. If possible, we should also have a friendly message that mentions that the wrong content type is being used. ### Relevant logs and/or screenshots ```sh ==> /var/log/gitlab/gitlab-workhorse/current <== {"correlation_id":"01GKMTCDYYDPNX0TQ5D0W06PQX","error":"handleFileUploads: extract files from multipart: get multipart reader: no multipart boundary param in Content-Type","level":"error","method":"POST","msg":"","time":"2022-12-06T22:54:55Z","uri":"/api/v4/projects"} {"content_type":"text/plain; charset=utf-8","correlation_id":"01GKMTCDYYDPNX0TQ5D0W06PQX","duration_ms":0,"host":"gitlab.example.com","level":"info","method":"POST","msg":"access","proto":"HTTP/1.1","referrer":"","remote_addr":"127.0.0.1:0","remote_ip":"127.0.0.1","route":"^/api/v4/projects\\z","status":500,"system":"http","time":"2022-12-06T22:54:55Z","ttfb_ms":0,"uri":"/api/v4/projects","user_agent":"xxxxxxx","written_bytes":22} ==> /var/log/gitlab/nginx/gitlab_access.log <== x.x.x.x - - [06/Dec/2022:22:54:55 +0000] "POST /api/v4/projects HTTP/1.1" 500 22 "" "xxxxxxxx" - ``` ### Output of checks #### Results of GitLab environment info
Expand for output related to GitLab environment info 

(For installations with omnibus-gitlab package run and paste the output of:
`sudo gitlab-rake gitlab:env:info`)

(For installations from source run and paste the output of:
`sudo -u git -H bundle exec rake gitlab:env:info RAILS_ENV=production`)
#### Results of GitLab application Check
Expand for output related to the GitLab application check 

(For installations with omnibus-gitlab package run and paste the output of:
`sudo gitlab-rake gitlab:check SANITIZE=true`)

(For installations from source run and paste the output of:
`sudo -u git -H bundle exec rake gitlab:check RAILS_ENV=production SANITIZE=true`)

(we will only investigate if the tests are passing)
### Possible fixes From [Slack](https://gitlab.slack.com/archives/C2TDMHW69/p1670375572509939): > @jacobvosmaer-gitlab the fix would be in this switch statement https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/blob/66362f00af7988ae115317b3a620e96a630d90dc/workhorse/internal/upload/uploads.go#L53
